name: Multi-object volume rendering with ghosting
definition: A method to visualize inter-penetrating volumetric objects by decomposing a scalar field into three distinct logical objects: selection, ghost, and background, allowing independent control of appearance and spatial transformation.
summary: Multi-object volume rendering with ghosting visualizes overlapping structures by decomposing them into selection, ghost, and background layers, using a three-pass strategy to reduce occlusion and preserve spatial context.
